pr.body: Materializes the missing strict generated Task Packet for TP-DMX-COCKPIT-SAFE-ACTIONS-001 and indexes it for Cockpit Phase 1 traceability. This is artifact-only and does not change runtime behavior, execute actions, upload to Claude Design, approve final screens, authorize T4 remote mutation, add live adapters, add canonical writes, or runtime-reclassify Unknown/Drift rows. It preserves safe_for_claude_design: NO and READY_FOR_CLAUDE_DESIGN: not approved.
